name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: A tab bar and its panels. Wraps @base-ui/react/tabs: Base UI owns which tab is selected, arrow-key roving focus and the tablist/tab/tabpanel ARIA; we own the muted pill list and the raised face of the selected tab.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/tabs

Installed to `components/ui/tabs.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/tabs

Requires the `@interlace/theme` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency).
